# optimizelycmssaas_content_source (Resource)

An external content source (e.g. a Graph source) surfaced in the CMS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Content sources surface items from an external source (for example Optimizely Graph).
# The CMS ships built-in ones (Item, AssetItem, ...); this manages your own.
resource "optimizelycmssaas_content_source" "products" {
  key          = "Products"
  type         = "graph"
  source_key   = "default"
  source_type  = "Product"
  display_name = "Products"
  base_type    = "_page"

  property_mappings = {
    key          = "_itemMetadata.key"
    display_name = "_itemMetadata.displayName"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_type` (String) Base type of the corresponding content type, e.g. _page.
- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the CMS for this source.
- `key` (String) Unique key. Cannot be changed.
- `property_mappings` (Attributes) How source items map to CMS items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--property_mappings))
- `source_key` (String) Key of the source this content source relates to.
- `source_type` (String) Source type within the source.
- `type` (String) Source kind, e.g. graph.

<a id="nestedatt--property_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `property_mappings`

Optional:

- `display_name` (String) Item display name in the CMS.
- `key` (String) Item key in the source. Required unless source_type is _Item. Cannot be changed.
- `key_format` (String) Format of the source identifier, e.g. digits, digitsWithHyphens.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import optimizelycmssaas_content_source.products Products
```
